name: Crisis
overview: Scripture reveals that crises are inevitable and often accompanied by fear and uncertainty, yet God calls His people to remain steadfast in faith and praise, as David exemplified by blessing the Lord continually despite adversity (Psalms 34:1). The righteous are assured that God hears their cries and delivers them from troubles (Psalms 34:17), while His plans for His people are rooted in peace and hope for a future (Jeremiah 29:11). Jesus warns of ongoing turmoil before the end times but encourages believers to endure faithfully and remain ready for His return, promising salvation to those who persevere until the end (Matthew 24:6, 13, 44).
